full_judgment: 2. The facts, in short, are that one Jetindra Nath Paddar, Inspector, District Anti-Corruption Bureau, Satkhira, lodged a first information report on 31-8-1995 stating, inter alia, that the appellant filed a mutation case before the Upazila Revenue Officer, Satkhira, on 11-8-1984. He had also submitted a photostat certified copy of a decree of Title Suit No. 663 of 1978 of the Second Court of Munsif, Satkhira in support of his case. The appellant prayed for mutating his name in respect of 0.44 decimals of land in plot No. 1858 of SA Khatian No. 983 under 101 Kotia Mouza with Satkhira PS.
